name: iptv-nova-plus
description: IPTV Nova Plus - Ultra HD Smart TV & Desktop Media Player
author: Christian Montano

scripts.build:tv: npm run build && npm run prepare:tv
scripts.package:webos: npm run build:tv && npx ares-package platforms/webos/build -o dist-packages
scripts.package:tizen: npm run build:tv && C:\tizen-studio\tools\ide\bin\tizen.bat package -t wgt -s IPTVNova -o dist-packages -- platforms/tizen/build && copy "dist-packages\IPTV Nova Plus.wgt" "dist-packages\IPTVNovaPlus.wgt"
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && copy android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk dist-packages\IPTV_Nova_Plus.apk
